name: Oxford Standard Pattern (Undergraduate)
description: Oxford undergraduate degree classification system. Three 8-week terms per year: Michaelmas (Oct-Dec), Hilary (Jan-Mar), Trinity (Apr-Jun). Final examinations at end of academic year (Prelims in Y1, Finals in Y3). Class degree: First (70+), Upper Second/2:1 (60-69), Lower Second/2:2 (50-59), Third (45-49), Pass (40-44).

in_semester.name: Collections / Term Tests
in_semester.notes: Internal college assessments (collections) at start/end of term for progress monitoring. Tutorials with weekly essays/problem sheets. No formal in-term marks contributing to final degree.

instructions: Answer the required number of questions from each section.
All questions carry equal marks unless otherwise stated.
Start each question on a new page.
Calculators are not permitted unless specified.

question_structure.description: University examinations (Prelims/Finals) occur at the end of the academic year. Each subject paper is typically 3 hours with essay and/or problem-style questions. Students choose a subset of questions from a larger set.
